headline: "It was a matter of humanity": Spanish government approves new housing package after rejection in Parliament
summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced 21 housing measures after the rejection in Parliament. The package includes affordable rental mechanisms, limits on rent increases, more housing supply and action against speculation.
why: Spain's housing policy shapes rental market regulation and real estate investment conditions, which matter to property investors and lenders.
